Add string-based JSON input support for question content APIs

- Add `FromString` variants for normalization, rendering, and plain text
  functions in both Dart and TypeScript
- Update test suites to cover JSON string input for question content
- Update Rust DTOs to clarify that `stem`, `answer`, and `analysis`
  fields
  are structured content JSON strings
- Add utility functions to parse JSON strings to structured content
- Update Camellia editor command lists and placeholders for clarity
